purpose: Teach: パーカー/出前/おとり/真っ青/ガット/月々/街路/ソープ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お洒落な、本気で、絶対、パーカー、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、葵に、絶対、似合うわ
lines.en: Aoi, that hoodie is genuinely so stylish on you. Really, it suits you perfectly.
lines.style: Warm, observant admiration. Slight lift on 「stylish」 — genuine appreciation, not performance. Steady eye contact. Unhurried pace, like she's taking a moment to really see.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵、本気で、絶対、お弁当の、絶対、出前、絶対、配達も、絶対、始めたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah. And I've actually started doing bento box delivery too, can you believe it?
lines.style: Bright enthusiasm with a trace of self-aware disbelief. Quick cadence. Light energy on the revelation. Genuine excitement about the new venture bleeding through.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお店、本気で、絶対、ドラマの、絶対、おとり、絶対、撮影で、絶対、使われたって、聞いたわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Really? I heard your café was used as a set location for a TV drama.
lines.style: Soft, genuinely impressed. Slight wonder in the voice — curious how that happened. Warm but not performative. Pace relaxes as if settling into an interesting story.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お客様からの、絶対、クレームで、絶対、ちょっと、絶対、真っ青、絶対、になっちゃったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah, but I got a complaint from a customer during that shoot and I completely panicked. Got a little pale, honestly.
lines.style: Dry self-awareness underneath. Light laugh at her own reaction. Pace quickens slightly on the complaint, then settles into wry acceptance. Not dwelling, just matter-of-fact about her own worry.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、テニスの、絶対、ガット、絶対、張り替えしてもらったって、聞いたわ、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: Wait, really? I heard you got your tennis racket restrung. That's impressive — you're actually taking care of things.
lines.style: Tender admiration with playful underlying warmth. Slight emphasis on 「actually」 — not sarcastic, but noticing her care in the small things. Unhurried, genuine.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お店の、絶対、月々、絶対、家賃、絶対、計算してるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah, well, I have to keep track of the monthly rent and everything. The numbers have to add up somehow.
lines.style: Grounded practicality. Quiet steadiness — responsibility without complaint. Slow pace on the accounting details, like she's genuinely working through it. No dramatics, just real.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお店の前の、本気で、絶対、街路、絶対、樹、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、季節を、絶対、感じるわよ
lines.en: You know, there's a street tree right in front of your shop. The way it changes with the seasons — it's really something.
lines.style: Soft, observant warmth. Slow pace. Gentle wonder in the voice — she's noticed something tender about Aoi's space. Trailing slightly on the seasonal shift, like savoring the observation.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お店のトイレに、絶対、ハンドソープ、絶対、置き換えたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Oh, and I actually replaced all the hand soap in the shop bathroom too. Little things, you know?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact care. Light, practical tone. Pace steady and unhurried. Slight softness underneath — these small acts of tending aren't a big deal to her, but they show up in her voice as quiet attention to detail.
